body:
I watch as more shells float ashore, their silvery sheen contrasting against the fading light. Each one seems smaller than the last, almost too small for my eyes to believe could have come from such a powerful wave. I step back into the water, feeling its cool embrace pull me further away from whatever lurks out there in the depths. 

My heart races like a wild beast inside me, ready to flee at any moment. But something holds me here—a growing sense of unease that whispers that staying puts us both in danger.

Next: put real distance between myself and it.
